preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The city Bash lives in s is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Cities u and v are between 1 and n, inclusive.
Cities u and v are different.
The length of the road w is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the maximum number of Bash's friends who can be made unhappy by destroying exactly one city.
